import pandas as pd import numpy as np from tqdm import tqdm import folium from folium.plugins import MarkerCluster print("en marche") antenne = pd.read_csv("data/SUP_ANTENNE.txt", sep=";", encoding="latin-1", low_memory=False) support = pd.read_csv("data/SUP_SUPPORT.txt", sep=";", encoding="latin-1", low_memory=False) station = pd.read_csv("data/SUP_STATION.txt", sep=";", encoding="latin-1", low_memory=False) datacenter = pd.read_csv("data/datacenter.txt", sep=";", encoding="latin-1", low_memory=False) def dms_to_dd(deg, mn, sc, direction): dd = deg + mn / 60 + sc / 3600 mask = direction.isin(["S", "W"]) dd[mask] *= -1 return dd # ← était désindentée support["lat"] = dms_to_dd( support["COR_NB_DG_LAT"], support["COR_NB_MN_LAT"], support["COR_NB_SC_LAT"].astype(str).str.replace(",", ".").astype(float), support["COR_CD_NS_LAT"] ) support["lon"] = dms_to_dd( support["COR_NB_DG_LON"], support["COR_NB_MN_LON"], support["COR_NB_SC_LON"].astype(str).str.replace(",", ".").astype(float), support["COR_CD_EW_LON"] ) support = support[ (support["lat"].between(43.17, 43.42)) & (support["lon"].between(5.20, 5.55)) ] # Fusion antennes + support + station df = antenne.merge( support[["SUP_ID", "lat", "lon", "SUP_NM_HAUT", "ADR_LB_ADD1", "COM_CD_INSEE"]], on="SUP_ID", how="left" ) df = df.merge( station[["STA_NM_ANFR", "ADM_ID", "DTE_EN_SERVICE"]], on="STA_NM_ANFR", how="left" ) df = df.dropna(subset=["lat", "lon"]) df["AER_NB_AZIMUT"] = pd.to_numeric(df["AER_NB_AZIMUT"], errors="coerce") df["AER_NB_ALT_BAS"] = pd.to_numeric( df["AER_NB_ALT_BAS"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "."), errors="coerce" ) print(f"{len(df):,} antennes géolocalisées") # Regroupement par support # Chaque ligne de `supports_grouped` représente un pylône/mât unique, # avec la liste des antennes qui y sont accrochées. supports_grouped = ( df.groupby("SUP_ID", sort=False) .agg( lat = ("lat", "first"), # coordonnées identiques lon = ("lon", "first"), # pour un même support hauteur_support = ("SUP_NM_HAUT", "first"), adresse = ("ADR_LB_ADD1", "first"), insee = ("COM_CD_INSEE", "first"), nb_antennes = ("AER_ID", "count"), # nombre d'antennes azimuths = ("AER_NB_AZIMUT", list), # liste des azimuths operateurs = ("ADM_ID", lambda x: list(x.dropna().unique())), stations = ("STA_NM_ANFR", lambda x: list(x.dropna().unique())), ) .reset_index() ) print(f"{len(supports_grouped):,} supports distincts") print(supports_grouped[["SUP_ID", "lat", "lon", "nb_antennes", "operateurs"]].head(20)) # Sauvegarde supports_grouped.to_parquet("data/antennes_merged.parquet", index=False) supports_grouped.to_parquet("data/supports_grouped.parquet", index=False) print("Sauvegardé → data/antennes_merged.parquet") print("Sauvegardé → data/supports_grouped.parquet") print("Construction map.") m = folium.Map(location=[43.30, 5.37], zoom_start=13) cluster = MarkerCluster().add_to(m) for _, row in tqdm(supports_grouped.iterrows()): operateurs_str = ", ".join(str(o) for o in row["operateurs"]) popup = folium.Popup( f""" Support {row['SUP_ID']}
Antennes : {row['nb_antennes']}
Opérateurs : {operateurs_str}
Hauteur : {row['hauteur_support']} m
{row['adresse']} """, max_width=250 ) folium.CircleMarker( location=[row["lat"], row["lon"]], radius=5, color="#e05c00", fill=True, fill_opacity=0.8, popup=popup, tooltip=f"{row['nb_antennes']} antenne(s)" ).add_to(cluster) m.save("data/carte_supports.html") print(f"Carte sauvegardée ({len(supports_grouped):,} supports)")
